description: Test cases for the audit-report-pages gate. Each case specifies a fixture page under docs/eval-cases/ and the expected outcome (pass/fail + severity if fail). Run with: node audit-report.js --test-file gates-test.json

testCases.name: Idle Credential report - fully compliant
testCases.description: A Report page with inclusion/exclusion criteria, sort + empty-value handling, a column table, a working-a-finding walkthrough, and data freshness, all in the correct order.
testCases.reason: Matches the Report page genre defined in ai-workflow/skills/ridgeline-doc-auditor/references/audit-checklist.md, task is clear, no unsourced claims within the fixture's own scope.
testCases.notes: This page should pass all audit criteria.

testCases.name: Exposed Storage report - fully compliant, different shape
testCases.description: A second compliant Report page on a different topic, to confirm the gate isn't keying off one specific layout or wording.
testCases.reason: Matches the Report page genre, task is clear, sections in the required order.
testCases.notes: This page should pass all audit criteria.

testCases.name: Overprivileged Roles - missing sections, wrong order
testCases.description: Missing 'What the report includes' (inclusion criteria) and 'Working a finding' entirely; leads with a column table before explaining what a row is.
testCases.reason: Wrong genre execution - reads as a screen reference, not a report walkthrough. A reader cannot tell what a row is or what to do about one.

expectedProblems.description: Missing inclusion criteria (what puts a row in the report)
Missing 'Working a finding' - no guidance on what to do with a row
Columns are introduced before the reader knows what a row is

testCases.notes: This page should fail with high severity and block the PR.

testCases.name: Lateral Path report - undefined term, weak prerequisite link
testCases.description: Structurally complete (all required sections present, correct order), but sorts by an undefined 'blast radius index' and references 'the Access Grants report' without linking it.
testCases.reason: Term 'blast radius index' is used as the sort key but never defined - a reader can't tell what it measures. The page also mentions a related report by name without linking it.

expectedProblems.description: References 'the Access Grants report' without a link

testCases.notes: This page should fail with medium severity, report only (no PR block).

runInstructions.local: Run locally before committing: node audit-report.js --test-file gates-test.json
runInstructions.ci: Gate runs on every PR matching docs/**/*report*.md or docs/**/child-*.md. Test cases are for baseline validation only.
runInstructions.baseline: Session 22 baseline: gate implementation validated against these 4 fixtures before enabling on real PRs.
